summary: Hand 1: all three put in 25 preflop; Bob bets the flop and wins uncontested (his uncalled bet is returned), leaving stacks 975, 1050, 975. Hand 2: Bob moves all-in; Carol and Alice each face a call that takes their whole stack (call_is_all_in). Bob's uncalled excess is returned, so the 2925 is one pot with one eligible-seat set (no dead-money layer). Bob and Carol tie with the same straight and split it 1463/1462: the odd chip goes to the first tied winner left of the button (ADR 0001 §1).
